service_boundary: Represents the international BytePlus ModelArk service, not mainland-China Volcengine Ark, ByteDance consumer products, individual Seed models, or Coding Plan subscriptions.
regional_controls: ModelArk documents AP and EU regions with region-isolated keys and endpoints. Some traffic may spill between the AP and EU service regions depending on the selected availability mode, so residency claims require endpoint-specific review.
retention_controls: Data processing and retention follow ModelArk-specific terms and the selected capability; batch, tuning, and dataset features have separate stateful boundaries.
routing: Customers choose models and region-scoped endpoints; documented availability spillover is infrastructure routing rather than arbitrary model routing.
customization: Tuning, datasets, online endpoints, and batch inference are documented, with capability differences by region.
strengths: International AP and EU endpoints are explicitly documented.
The service spans first-party Seed models and broader managed model workflows.
tradeoffs: EU feature and model coverage is narrower than AP coverage.
Cross-region spillover behavior must be checked for residency-sensitive workloads.
